snippet.title: Speed Creators Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Speed Creators on steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1745860/Speed_Creators/

Speed Creators is a multiplayer action platformer where you and your friends separately make levels and then race through all of them stitched together.  I was inspired by speed runners but I wanted to be able to play with more people.  So you can play with up to 200 people (theoretically (at least 30 for sure)).

The music for this trailer comes from here:
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PH6mWsP9t_U
